arxiv-2106-08138.title: Learning Full Configuration Interaction Electron Correlations with Deep Learning
arxiv-2106-08138.creator: Hector H. Corzo, Arijit Sehanobish, Onur Kara
arxiv-2106-08138.description: Abstract In this report, we present a deep learning framework termed the Electron Correlation Potential Neural Network (eCPNN) that can learn succinct and compact potential functions. These functions can effectively describe the complex instantaneous spatial correlations among electrons in many–electron atoms.

arxiv-2204-13975.title: Conditional average treatment effect estimation with marginally constrained models
arxiv-2204-13975.creator: Wouter A.C. van Amsterdam, Rajesh Ranganath
arxiv-2204-13975.description: Abstract Treatment effect estimates are often available from randomized controlled trials as a single average treatment effect for a certain patient population. Estimates of the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) are more useful for individualized treatment decision making, but randomized trials are often too small to estimate the CATE.

arxiv-2212-06518.title: Autonomous Upper Stage Guidance with Robust Splash-Down Constraint
arxiv-2212-06518.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel algorithm, based on model predictive control (MPC), for the optimal guidance of a launch vehicle upper stage. The proposed strategy not only maximizes the performance of the vehicle and its robustness to external disturbances, but also robustly enforces the splash-down constraint.

arxiv-2303-03819.title: Comparative study of the heavy-quark dynamics with the Fokker-Planck Equation and the Plastino-Plastino Equation
arxiv-2303-03819.creator: Eugenio Megías, Airton Deppman, Roman Pasechnik, Constantino Tsallis
arxiv-2303-03819.description: Abstract The Fokker-Planck Equation (FPE) is a fundamental tool for the investigation of kinematic aspects of a wide range of systems. For systems governed by the non-additive entropy S q S_{q} , the Plastino-Plastino Equation (PPE) is the correct generalization describing the kinematic evolution of such complex systems.

arxiv-2309-04067.title: Prediction of the Cu Oxidation State from EELS and XAS Spectra Using Supervised Machine Learning
arxiv-2309-04067.creator: Samuel P. Gleason, Deyu Lu, Jim Ciston
arxiv-2309-04067.description: Abstract Electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) provide detailed information about bonding, distributions and locations of atoms, and their coordination numbers and oxidation states. However, analysis of XAS/EELS data often relies on matching an unknown experimental sample to a series of simulated or experimental standard samples.

arxiv-2504-12254.title: Advancing Arabic Speech Recognition Through Large-Scale Weakly Supervised Learning
arxiv-2504-12254.creator: Mahmoud Salhab, Marwan Elghitany, Shameed Sait, Syed Sibghat Ullah, Mohammad Abusheikh, and Hasan Abusheikh CNTXT AI AI Department Abu Dhabi, UAE {mahmoud.salhab,marwan.elghitany,shameed.ali,syed.sibghat,mas,has}@cntxt.tech
arxiv-2504-12254.description: Abstract Automatic speech recognition (ASR) is crucial for human-machine interaction in diverse applications like conversational agents, industrial robotics, call center automation, and automated subtitling. However, developing high-performance ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages like Arabic, due to the scarcity of large, labeled speech datasets, which are costly and labor-intensive to produce.

arxiv-2504-19620.title: From local to collective superconductivity in proximitized graphene
arxiv-2504-19620.creator: Stefano Trivini, Tim Kokkeler, Jon Ortuzar, Eva Cortés-del Río, Beatriz Viña Bausá, Pierre Mallet, Jean-Yves Veuillen, Juan Carlos Cuevas, Ivan Brihuega, F. Sebastian Bergeret, Jose Ignacio Pascual
arxiv-2504-19620.description: Abstract The superconducting proximity effect induces pairing correlations in metallic systems via Andreev scattering. This effect is particularly intriguing in graphene, as it enables two-dimensional superconductivity that is tunable through doping. Understanding how superconducting correlations propagate within the metal is crucial to unveiling the key factors behind this tunability.

arxiv-2506-00981.title: What do self-supervised speech models know about Dutch? Analyzing advantages of language-specific pre-training
arxiv-2506-00981.creator: Marianne, Hosein, Charlotte, Gaofei, Willem, Martijn
arxiv-2506-00981.description: Abstract How language-specific are speech representations learned by self-supervised models? Existing work has shown that a range of linguistic features can be successfully decoded from end-to-end models trained only on speech recordings. However, it’s less clear to what extent pre-training on specific languages improves language-specific linguistic information.

arxiv-2507-05590.creator: Pete B. Kuzma, Miho N. Ishigaki, Takanobu Kirihara, Itsuki Ogami
arxiv-2507-05590.description: Abstract Globular Clusters (GCs) displaying extended structures are becoming increasingly ubiquitous in the Milky Way (MW). Despite their low surface brightness, which makes disentangling the true structure from the MW overwhelming difficult, the increasing availability of multi-dimensional data sets has allowed for new detections of extended GC structure.

arxiv-2509-19665.title: Deep Learning for Clouds and Cloud Shadow Segmentation in Methane Satellite and Airborne Imaging Spectroscopy
arxiv-2509-19665.creator: Manuel Pérez-Carrasco, Maya Nasr, Sébastien Roche, Chris Chan Miller, Zhan Zhang, Core Francisco Park, Eleanor Walker, Cecilia Garraffo, Douglas Finkbeiner, Ritesh Gautam, Steven Wofsy
arxiv-2509-19665.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Manuel Pérez-Carrasco, Maya Nasr, Sébastien Roche, Chris Chan Miller, Zhan Zhang, Core Francisco Park, Eleanor Walker, Cecilia Garraffo, Douglas Finkbeiner, Ritesh Gautam, Steven Wofsy. Effective cloud and cloud shadow detection is a critical prerequisite for accurate retrieval of concentrations of atmospheric methane (CH 4 ) or other trace gases in hyperspectral remote sensing.

arxiv-2511-04787.title: Comprehensive Listing of 208 Nova White Dwarf Masses As the Primary Determinant of Spectral-Class and Light-Curve-Class
arxiv-2511-04787.creator: Bradley E. Schaefer
arxiv-2511-04787.description: Abstract For Galactic novae, I calculate and collect a comprehensive catalog of 208 measures of white dwarf (WD) masses ( M WD M_{\rm WD} ) and 232 measures of average V V magnitudes in quiescence ( V q V_{q} ). These are collected into a comprehensive catalog of most fundamental properties of all 402 known Galactic novae.

pmc-10538623.title: Crop/Plant Modeling Supports Plant Breeding: II. Guidance of Functional Plant Phenotyping for Trait Discovery
pmc-10538623.creator: Pengpeng Zhang, Jingyao Huang, Yuntao Ma, Xiujuan Wang, Mengzhen Kang, Youhong Song
pmc-10538623.description: Observable morphological traits are widely employed in plant phenotyping for breeding use, which are often the external phenotypes driven by a chain of functional actions in plants. Identifying and phenotyping inherently functional traits for crop improvement toward high yields or adaptation to harsh environments remains a major challenge.

pmc-11509378.title: A Novel Sensing Method to Detect Malachite Green Contaminant on Silicon Substrate Using Nonlinear Optics
pmc-11509378.creator: Muhammad Ahyad, Hendradi Hardhienata, Eddwi Hesky Hasdeo, Sasfan Arman Wella, Faridah Handayasari, Husin Alatas, Muhammad Danang Birowosuto, Nam-Trung Nguyen, Igor Medintz, Ai-Qun Liu, Mehmet Remzi Dokmeci
pmc-11509378.description: We propose a nonlinear-optics-based nanosensor to detect malachite green (MG) contaminants on semiconductor interfaces such as silicon (Si). Applying the simplified bond hyperpolarizability model (SBHM), we simplified the second-harmonic generation (SHG) analysis of an MG-Si(111) surface and were able to validate our model by reproducing experimental rotational anisotropy (RA) SHG experiments.

pmc-11674577.title: Age-related unstable transient states and imbalanced activation proportion of brain networks in people with autism spectrum disorder: A resting-state fMRI study using coactivation pattern analyses
pmc-11674577.creator: Yunge Zhang, Lin Lin, Dongyue Zhou, Yang Song, Abigail Stein, Shuqin Zhou, Huashuai Xu, Wei Zhao, Fengyu Cong, Jin Sun, Huanjie Li, Fei Du
pmc-11674577.description: The atypical static brain functions related to the executive control network (ECN), default mode network (DMN), and salience network (SN) in people with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) has been widely reported. However, their transient functions in ASD are not clear.

pmc-12597969.title: Predicting the Pharmacokinetics of T‐Cell Engagers as a Function of Target‐Mediated Drug Disposition
pmc-12597969.creator: Mark Penney, Alberto Ippolito, Elisa Fevola, Scott Rata, Liam Brown, Pablo Morentin Gutierrez, Rhys D O Jones
pmc-12597969.description: T‐Cell Engagers (TCEs) are biological multi‐specific molecules designed to co‐engage targets on T cells and on a target cell for destruction. Molecular formats are typically derived from IgG monoclonal antibodies or similar fusion proteins with FcRn‐mediated recycling, such as albumin binders.

pmc-12652754.title: Unraveling Obesity: A Five-Year Integrative Review of Transcriptomic Data
pmc-12652754.creator: Svetlana Tarbeeva, Anna Kliuchnikova, Anna Kozlova, Elizaveta Sarygina, Ekaterina Ilgisonis, Elena Ponomarenko, Valeria Magnelli
pmc-12652754.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Omics approaches have advanced insight into molecular mechanisms of human obesity. We reviewed transcriptomic studies published between January 2020 and June 2025 that used human tissues or human cell lines and applied high-throughput RNA methods.

pmc-12752902.title: Efficacy of Periodontal Surgery on Subgingival Periodontopathogen Levels in Periodontitis Patients: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-12752902.creator: Cansu Bayram, Ece Açıkgöz-Alparslan
pmc-12752902.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluates the changes in subgingival periodontopathogens following access flap surgery (AFS) in Stage III Grade B periodontitis patients.Materials and MethodsThis randomized clinical split‐mouth study included 20 systemically healthy periodontitis patients. Participants’ right and left quadrants were randomly assigned to the control (nonsurgery) or test (AFS) group.

pmc-12884618.title: DFT studies of metal oxide nanocluster as a possible drug delivery system for mechlorethamine
pmc-12884618.creator: Shahnaz Azari gharelar, Shiva Masoudi, Nasrin Masnabadi, Mohammad Hadi Ghasemi
pmc-12884618.description: This study examined the adsorption of the mechlorethamine (ME) anti-cancer drug loaded upon Mg12O12 nanocage using DFT: B3LYP (6-31G* and 6-311G** basis set) and B3PW91 (6-31G* basis set) calculations. To clarify the electronic, thermochemical, and structural properties of drug (ME) complexes with Mg12O12 nanocages, DFT calculations were combined with the Quantum Theory of Atoms in Molecules (QTAIM) study.

pmc-13082345.title: A Digital Diabetes Prevention Program for Hispanic Adolescents (Fit24+): Protocol for a Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13082345.creator: Erica G Soltero, Marbelly Partida, Sandra Mihail, Lizette Villanueva, Callie Lopez, Salma M Musaad, Teresia M O'Connor, Maria J Redondo, Matthew Buman, Debbe Thompson, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-13082345.description: BackgroundHispanic youth are disproportionately impacted by obesity and subsequent type 2 diabetes (T2D) yet remain underrepresented in diabetes prevention research. Digital health interventions hold promise for increasing the accessibility to and engagement in disease prevention programming, particularly among high-risk populations. However, there is a significant gap in the literature regarding digital T2D prevention programs for adolescents or Hispanic youth.

pmc-13114468.title: Prospective Pilot Study of Ultrasound Resolution Microscopy Imaging (URM) for Differentiating Benign and Malignant Breast Lesions: A Quantitative Microvascular Parameter Analysis
pmc-13114468.creator: Fan Li, Nuo Xu, Jun Wu, Rui Hu, Zhi Chen, Ji’ao You, Xiaofeng Lan, Fang Ma, Xiang Xie
pmc-13114468.description: Objective: Ultrasound Resolution Microscopy (URM) is an emerging technique that provides superior delineation of tumor microvasculature. This prospective study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic value of URM in differentiating benign from malignant breast lesions. Methods: From September 2024 to October 2025, 55 patients with 57 breast masses underwent conventional ultrasound and contrast-enhanced URM.

pmc-13266352.title: Imaging for Pediatric Head and Neck Emergencies: Critical Insights
pmc-13266352.creator: Gayoung Choi, Bo-Kyung Je
pmc-13266352.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Nontraumatic head and neck emergencies in children are common and often infectious, with overlapping and nonspecific clinical presentations that can delay accurate diagnosis. Imaging plays a critical role in distinguishing self-limited conditions from conditions requiring urgent intervention. This review provides an anatomically organized overview of pediatric orbital, sinonasal, oral cavity, deep neck, temporal bone, and skull base emergencies and foreign-body events.
